Description: The physical-to-analytical transform only checks whether unit and dimension metadata are missing, empty, or TBD. It does not validate dimension identifiers against the DEL-02-02 unit DimensionId vocabulary, and the transform test fixture uses dimensions such as second_moment_area and stiffness that are absent or differently named in schemas/units.schema.yaml. Solver-ready analytical output cannot be treated as unit-contract-compatible until this vocabulary mismatch is reconciled.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: transform quantity traversal now validates dimension identifiers against the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary, test fixtures use second_moment_area and linear_stiffness, and retired area_moment is covered by a blocking PTA-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN test. Evidence: python3 -m pytest tests/test_physical_to_analytical_transform.py passed on 2026-05-16.

Description: DEL-13-04 emits a derived analytical model, diagnostics, and traceability links that are natural persistence and downstream handoff surfaces, but the local dependency register does not include DEL-02-05 and the implementation does not bind output to project persistence, round-trip, or hash/provenance manifest semantics.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: package-local dependency evidence now includes DEL-02-05 persistence/hash/round-trip as an upstream reconciliation row for transform outputs. This does not claim the in-memory transform output is a persisted or handoff-ready artifact. Evidence: Dependencies.csv and _DEPENDENCIES.md updated on 2026-05-16.
